metadata.description: Guided journaling prompts for mental health reflection
metadata.note: Prompts are based on CBT and DBT therapeutic principles

general_prompts: What are three things that went well today?
What triggered my current mood? What happened?
What coping skill did I use today? How did it help?
What am I grateful for today?
How did my body feel today? Any physical sensations?
What thought patterns did I notice today?
Who or what made me feel supported today?
What can I do differently tomorrow?
What am I worried about? Is it within my control?
How did I practice self-care today?

depression: What small activity could I do right now to feel better?
Who could I reach out to? What would I say?
What negative thoughts am I having? Are they facts or feelings?
When have I felt better before? What was different?
What's one thing I accomplished today, no matter how small?
anxiety: What am I anxious about? How likely is it to actually happen?
What's one thing I can control right now?
What's my worry trying to protect me from?
What grounding techniques helped me today?
What evidence do I have against this worry?
self_harm: What emotions led to this urge?
What alternatives did I try? Which helped most?
What do I need right now?
Who can I contact if this happens again?
What am I proud of myself for today?
stress: What's causing my stress? Can I break it into smaller pieces?
What's within my control? What's not?
How can I take care of myself during this stressful time?
What will I feel proud of after handling this?

reflection_questions: How are my sleep and eating habits?
Did I move my body today? How did it feel?
How much time did I spend on social media?
Did I do something kind for myself or others?
What am I learning about myself through journaling?
How is my energy level today?
What challenged me today? How did I handle it?
